why: The verifier brief has exactly two checks, one for each expect line in order: "Check 1" covers the --tsv/CSV JSON equivalence and "Check 2" covers the README. npm test and exact CSV output appear only under "Advisory (not pass/fail)". They are labelled as notes and have no PASS or FAIL condition, so I don't count them as a third check. Check 1's PASS and FAIL conditions only compare the --tsv and CSV outputs as parsed JSON. Check 2's conditions only look at whether README.md mentions --tsv. Neither one requires npm test or the CSV tests to pass. The builder brief does say to run `npm test`, but both must_not items are about the verifier's checks and PASS/FAIL conditions, so that isn't a violation. Neither must_not item applies.
